# Adarsh Singh — Hands-on CTO

> Adarsh Singh is CTO at SmokeTrees Digital (India). He works across the stack
> on production systems, integrations, automation, and cloud infrastructure,
> and turns repeatable parts into templates so small teams deliver like bigger
> ones. Contact is email only: me@adarshsingh87.com.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://adarshsingh87.com/): profile, selected work, experience, stack, latest notes
- [Work archive](https://adarshsingh87.com/work): full project list, OSS and tooling first
- [Blog](https://adarshsingh87.com/blog): notes on tooling, ONDC lessons, reconciliation patterns, running a small eng team

## Selected work

- Smoke Context: context-management library for Express built on async storage; carries request-scoped context so logs trace without threading IDs through every function. [GitHub](https://github.com/smoke-trees/smoke-context)
- SmokeTrees Backend Template: opinionated backend starting point (TypeScript, Express, PostgreSQL). [GitHub](https://github.com/smoke-trees/node-template-ts)
- SmokeTrees Frontend Template: opinionated Next.js starting point (Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS). [GitHub](https://github.com/smoke-trees/next-FE-template)
- Fomofy / MyFomo: e-commerce product with discovery-focused views and recommendations. [myfomo.in](https://myfomo.in/)
- ONDC integrations: buyer-side and seller-side gift card flows plus a B2B retail seller implementation; production systems serving millions of customers.
- Reconciliation and financial automation: daily reconciliation flows handling 3Cr+ in transactions, plus finance-ops automation (50-60% repetitive manual work cut where applied).
- AI chatbots: client support and operations bots with retrieval over client docs and human handoff.
- Shopify connectors: orders, inventory, and storefront-to-system sync.
- Business applications: LMS, CRM, and rewards/recognition builds.

More detail on each: [Work archive](https://adarshsingh87.com/work)

## Stack

- Frontend / Mobile: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, React Native, Flutter
- Backend: Go, TypeScript, JavaScript, Express, Hono, Flask, FastAPI, LangChain
- Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, ElasticSearch
- Cloud / Deploy: AWS, Azure, Vercel, Cloudflare, Kubernetes
- Daily drivers: Arch Linux, Hyprland, Neovim, OpenCode

## Notes (blog)

- [Async context as a mental model, not just a library](https://adarshsingh87.com/blog/async-context-mental-model): AsyncLocalStorage as propagation bound to the async chain, not the process; when context fits observability data and when it hides business dependencies.
- [What building on ONDC taught me about the difference between an API and a protocol](https://adarshsingh87.com/blog/api-vs-protocol-ondc): no central author, async callbacks, defensive parsing, idempotency, and building for implementation drift.
